questions.question: Select the sentence which has no spelling error.
options: He is a very shrewd and garulous fellow.
Her normally garrullous mother had little to say on the subject.
My garrulous neighbour had given away the secret.
Desperate for peace and quiet, Amanda told the garrulus man sitting next to her to "Shut up!"
questions.solution:
The correct spelling is 'garrulous'. The correct sentence is mentioned in option (c).

'Garrulous' means talking a lot, mostly about unimportant things.

Hence, option (c) is correct.

questions.question:
In the following sentence, four words are underlined out of which one word is misspelt. Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

His comprehensive(A) knowledge of philosphy(B) enabled him to debate ethical dilemmas(C) with great clarity and insight(D).
questions.solution:
(A) comprehensive - Correctly spelt. Complete or thorough.

(B) philosphy - Incorrectly spelt. Correct spelling is "philosophy," meaning study of fundamental nature of knowledge and existence.

(C) dilemmas - Correctly spelt. Difficult situations requiring choice.

(D) insight - Correctly spelt. Deep understanding.

Hence, option (b) is the answer.

questions.question:
Select the correct spelling to fill in the blank.

His sudden outburst of anger was considered an _____ from his usual calm demeanour.
questions.solution:
"Aberration" means a departure from what is normal, usual, or expected, typically an unwelcome one. The other options are misspellings.

The complete sentence is: His sudden outburst of anger was considered an aberration from his usual calm demeanour.

Hence, option (a) is the answer.

questions.question:

questions.solution: The word 'caugh' is a misspelling of the word 'cough'. The word 'cough' is a reflex action that helps to clear the airways of irritants. It is a verb that is often used to describe the sound that someone makes when they cough. Hence, (c) is the correct answer.

questions.question:
In the following sentence, four words are underlined out of which one word is misspelt. Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word.

The architect designed an innovative infrastructure(A) that integrated both traditional aestetics(B) and modern functionality(C) to enhance urban living spaces(D).
questions.solution:
(A) infrastructure - Correctly spelt. Basic physical structures.

(B) aestetics - Incorrectly spelt. Correct spelling is "aesthetics". It means "relating to the enjoyment or study of beauty".

(C) functionality - Correctly spelt. Practical purpose or use.

(D) spaces - Correctly spelt. Areas or places.

Hence, option (b) is the answer.

questions.question: Select the correctly spelt word.
questions.solution:
"Iridescent" is correctly spelt. It means showing luminous colours that seem to change depending on the angle from which they are viewed.

"Neccesity" is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "necessity", which is the state or fact of being required.

"Ommission" is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "omission", which is someone or something that has been left out or excluded.

"Parrallel" is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "parallel", which means (of lines, planes, or surfaces) side by side and having the same distance continuously between them.

The only correctly spelt word among the options is "iridescent".

Hence, option (a) is the answer.

questions.question: Select the correctly spelt word.
questions.solution:
"Playwrite" is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "playwright", which is a person who writes plays.

"Quintessance" is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "quintessence", which refers to the most perfect or typical example of a quality or class.

"Phenomenon" is correctly spelt. It means a fact or situation that is observed to exist or happen, especially one whose cause or explanation is in question.

"Referrence" is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is "reference", which is the action of mentioning or alluding to something.

The only correctly spelt word among the options is "phenomenon".

Hence, option (c) is the answer.
